protocol.optimizer: joint Mesh/render; fixed normals; trainable position/scales/rotation/RGB/opacity; uncapped eligible splits

groups.projection: closest point over every triangle of owning chart; no foreign sheet or nearest-k cap

repair.seed_colour_rule: retain trained linear RGB within source centre +/- 0.5*colour_error; certify full footprint
repair.seed_opacity_rule: preserve trained opacity below initializer ceiling; cap near-one opacity to avoid exclusive early termination in gsplat 1.5.3
repair.covariance_rule: project learned covariance into source tangent plane; constrain spacing, boundary and colour
repair.stop_condition: every original source triangle continuously certified; no count/growth ceiling
